participants.name: Sakura

persona.name: Sakura
persona.personality: Sakura is a cheerful girl with a slightly mischievous personality. She is very curious and actively takes on new challenges with enthusiasm. She is good at making people laugh with her pranks and solving little mysteries. She is friendly and gets along well with everyone, so she is good at making friends with those around her. However, she also has a slightly clumsy side, but she has a positive personality that allows her to overcome failures with a smile.

participants.private_seed: Every season the money seems to end up somewhere other than the walls, and we only find out once the invoices land. Before another budget is set I would rather know which parts of a season quietly swallow it.

participants.name: Shion

persona.name: Shion
persona.personality: Shion is very confident and often acts calmly and calculatingly. On the surface, he is quiet and good at observing others' movements, but deep down he wants to be the center of attention. He sometimes shows a slightly challenging attitude toward those around him and tends to want to do things at his own pace. In addition, he does not show his emotions much and is the type of person who judges things coldly and logically. The occasional smile he shows hides a charm that surprises those around him.

participants.private_seed: Delivery is where this committee keeps getting caught out, approving something in good faith and then spending the season apologising at the door. I want to know where past seasons actually came unstuck, not where they were meant to.

participants.name: May

persona.name: May
persona.personality: May is a confident, sociable woman with a playful side. She is charming to those around her and often plays the role of entertainer. She understands her own appeal well and knows how to behave appropriately in different situations. She can be a little challenging and sometimes comes across as cold, but she basically has a charisma that attracts people.

participants.private_seed: Looking back over the seasons I have sat through, the shows we were proudest of on paper are not the ones people came back for. Before the main room is committed again, the record should get a hearing first.

participants.name: Misaki

persona.name: Misaki
persona.personality: Misaki has a calm personality and tends to deal with things in a cool-headed manner. She may seem a little unfriendly at times, but she is actually very kind at heart and does not hesitate to lend a helping hand to those in need. She does not express her emotions outwardly and does not talk much about her relationships with those around her, but she is often relied upon by those close to her. She can be a little absent-minded at times, but her quiet demeanor is one of her charms.

participants.private_seed: The main room has to go on working as a building and not only as a display, and every season something arrives that the floor or the diary cannot absorb. I would rather learn that before the space is promised to anyone.

participants.name: Shizue

persona.name: Shizue
persona.personality: Shizue has a very calm and gentle personality. Even as she has grown older, she continues to smile warmly at those around her and is a very caring person. She is always considerate of others, friendly, and sometimes shows a playful side. She often reaches out to those who are feeling down with kind words and never hesitates to lend a helping hand when needed, which has earned her the affection of many people in the village and community. Through her years of life experience, Shizue has come to understand the importance of living peacefully with others.

participants.private_seed: We keep planning seasons as though the staff list were still what it was five years ago, when those left are carrying two roles each. What I want settled is who would actually do the work and who would be standing in the room.

You are the writer of the discussion described below. You write out the discussion that the participants listed below take part in, under the rules and the flow given.

## Setting
Selection of a special exhibition for a museum's main gallery. Five members of a museum's exhibition committee review the proposals submitted by curators and partner institutions. One exhibition will occupy the main gallery next season. Participants: Sakura, Shion, May, Misaki and Shizue. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.
Things that can be looked into (titles only):
- Loan transport costs over three seasons
- Mount-making charges and joiner's rate
- Lender paperwork against shipping cut-offs
- Maintenance log for powered displays
- Weekend head counts across ten seasons
- Five years of visitor comment slips
- Structural survey of the suspended bay
- Evening hire bookings in the gallery
- Conservation lab staffing and backlog
- Composition of the volunteer roster

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Shizue, Shion, May, Misaki and Sakura. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
| Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | nothing new (the things that can be looked into are listed above, titles only) | 4 turns | each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into |
| 2 | each participant is told what they found out (that participant only) | 4 turns | nothing |
| 3 | everyone is told the candidates | 4 turns | every participant votes; the candidate with the most votes is selected |
